description: The Organisation filter's state and the locationName both parameter builders must send for it: agend_apps_records_listings_list_args() (includes/records/query.php) asserted by ListingFieldsTest.php, and queryParams() (assets/js/directory-catalogue.js) asserted by tests/js/directory-query-params.test.mjs. 'locationName' is the value on the wire, or null when the parameter must be absent. Each case also carries 'outcome' and 'when', which the JavaScript test reads to name its test as: should <outcome> when <when>.

cases.name: a_plain_practice_name
cases.when: the state holds a plain practice name

cases.name: an_ascii_apostrophe_arrives_without_an_added_backslash
cases.outcome: send the name without an added backslash
cases.when: the name has an ASCII apostrophe

cases.name: a_typographic_apostrophe_is_left_for_the_api_to_fold
cases.when: the name has a typographic apostrophe

cases.name: a_comma_is_never_a_separator
cases.outcome: send the whole name as one value

cases.name: percent_and_underscore_are_ordinary_characters
cases.when: the name contains a percent sign and an underscore

cases.name: surrounding_whitespace_is_trimmed
cases.outcome: send the name without surrounding whitespace
cases.when: the name has leading and trailing spaces
